name: Movies
description: The reference media extension, declared as typed C#. A Movie entity and a Collection group carry the schema as properties and attributes; the Movies type states what the attributes cannot, and the host derives the shape, the intent surface and the naming tokens from them. The release models, the quality ladder and the TMDb catalog mapping remain data; the catalog mapping is the only vendor-named thing left and leaves with the cataloger milestone.
